text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, we were doing racecourse simulation
training inside the VR Umalator.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...It's stiflingly hot, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ――Ah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: How's the time looking?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Based on the data collected up to this point,
I need to decide the parameters for her opponent
in the upcoming mock race, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we want to hone her finishing stretch, setting a target
for the fastest final leg makes sense.
Alternatively, since her stamina has improved recently—
choice_data_list: Maybe we could pick legendary stayers from the past!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Isn't that, like... getting a little too carried away?
Or rather, overestimating me way too much...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to late-race burst,
you won't lose to anyone!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to late-race burst,
you won't lose to anyone!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Then I'll believe enough for the both of us!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Then I will believe enough for the both of us!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (You're always complimenting me. Talking about believing in me, but based on what...? ...Do you actually have a reason?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be... they're just exaggerating
to hype me up, or something...?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...You're kind of riding high, aren't you?
Next you'll be telling me to race against all-time record holders,
like Rice or McQueen or someone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, surely that's a bit—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen and Rice Shower.
Both legendary stayers of the previous generation who set record times in the 3,200m turf in recent years.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It'll be a good learning experience to deliberately set up a stronger opponent
and experience a higher-level race.
Let's set that up right away.
choice_data_list: Think you can handle 3,200m for now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait... are you for real?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Kh... Aaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...
...Haha, totally wrecked...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (—Hah, well of course. It's pointless to expect anything from this... That's why...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Um, hey... Trai—
choice_data_list: That was a great run, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She stayed right on their heels, and because she was in the chasing position, it brought out her true grit—felt like her run had more power behind it than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we analyze this result thoroughly,
we'll have a much more critical understanding of what
training menu to use and what areas to improve going forward!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Why?
You totally got beaten to a pulp...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Disillusioned, or whatever...
I mean, running alongside someone so out of my league was pretty much impossible from the start—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Racing against stronger opponents teaches you a lot, even in defeat.
Using these experiences as fuel to further
polish her running would be ideal.
choice_data_list: You have the strength to turn this into nourishment, don't you?
You have the strength to turn that into nourishment, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Mm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "We should definitely keep running simulations against tough opponents going forward. Watching her run just now proved that it's worth it!"
choice_data_list: Let's keep using all this as fuel to grow!
Let's keep using all this as fuel to grow!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...What do you know.
When you said you believe in me... you really meant it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I-It's nothing!
The analysis, and the next menu. Let's get to it already.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Narita Taishin worked hard on her training,
seeming to be in a noticeably good mood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "We should definitely keep running simulations against tough opponents going forward. Watching her run just now proved that it's worth it!"
choice_data_list: Let's keep using all this as fuel to grow!
Let's keep using all this as fuel to grow!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, everything in moderation.
choice_data_list: I'll give you all the support I've got, too!
I'll support you with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, knock it off, I don't need that.
Uphill course is next, right? I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ngh, damn it, this is totally throwing me off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Narita Taishin was walking on air for a while
for some reason, but she gradually regained her composure
and powered through her training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, jumping straight into facing someone who's
set a record before is definitely gonna be rough.
Keep it reasonable, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, overloading them too much isn't good either.
It'd be best to adjust the parameters based on their growth data
to keep the competition neck and neck.
choice_data_list: Let's raise the level step by step!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...It's suffocatingly hot.
But well... I guess it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite her blunt attitude,
Narita Taishin was tackling this with great motivation...
I could really feel it.
